entities.summary: Chahār Bāgh School or the Chahār Bāgh Madrasa, also known as Madrese-ye Madar-e Shah, is a 17–18th century cultural complex in Isfahan, Iran. The compound was built during the reign of Soltan Hoseyn, a Safavid shah, to serve as a theological and clerical school.
